title: Massachusetts Ballot Questions: Smaller Lots for Starter Homes?
description:
A proposal among the Massachusetts ballot questions would legalize smaller lots for starter homes. An October 8, 2026 report describes the proposed change, not an enacted law. This update focuses on that distinction and the question facing prospective buyers: allowing smaller lots does not establish what a finished home would cost.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
